digestItems.instrument: Privacy Amendment (Personal Data Protection) Bill 2026 - tranche 2 exposure draft
digestItems.effectiveDate: TBD (government aims to legislate by 2026-12; not law)
digestItems.primarySource: SECONDARY - pending primary confirmation (AGD consultation page not verified); https://www.cbp.com.au/insights/publications/privacy-amendment-(personal-data-protection)-bill-2026-exposure-draft-released-for-second-tranche-o
digestItems.summary: Draft would legislate consent (voluntary, informed, current, specific, unambiguous), treat precise geolocation as sensitive, and require consent for disclosure for money/direct marketing. Consultation closed 2026-09-18. Cookie/pixel impact is vendor interpretation only.
digestItems.idPrivacySubsystem: Consent Banner; Geo/Jurisdiction Routing; Vendor/SDK Governance
digestItems.suggestedAction: Watch for bill introduction; scope AU opt-in ruleset only if enacted. Note ADM transparency commencement reported 2026-12-10 (not consent layer).

digestItems.effectiveDate: TBD (reported within 2 years of promulgation, by Cabinet Order)
digestItems.summary: APPI amendments promulgated after Diet passage 2026-07-10. Cookie-relevant 'personally referable information' consent-on-transfer concept already exists; changes to it not confirmed.
digestItems.suggestedAction: Obtain official text and PPC Cabinet Order timeline; confirm whether JP ruleset needs change.
